{{Quote|Most people like me have a real spacer's chest for our belongings. Something that'll take a beating and bounce back.|[[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]]|<ref name="SL">{{JournalCite|4|Smuggler's Log}}</ref>}}
'''Spacer's chests''' were durable containers in which [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] kept their belongings. They were considered useful for [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] that swapped [[Starship/Legends|ship]] frequently.<ref name="SL" /> They came in many shapes and sizes; some even looked like a typical [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo container]]. It was common for pilots to attach [[holo-sticker]]s from their travels to their chests, and for messages to be scratched onto the exterior.<ref name="PSG" />

Most chests were equipped with padded compartments to store fragile possessions, and other precautionary measures included vacuum and pressure seals. While this provided some protection from harsh environments, the chests were not capable of withstanding re-entry burn if ejected in orbit. The chests normally came with a standard lock but these were often replaced with electronic locking devices. A popular model was the [[Wanderer Space Chest]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. These cost around two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. An alternative to spacer's chests were the more portable [[gear bag]]s.<ref name="PSG" />
